text:
mira: Heads-up — Zenith Health just sign the MOU and wants reserved capacity + burst credits. Need quick alignment on: throughput sizing, preheat/KV warmup, GCP egress constraints, and a legal ask re: billing for burst usage. Can we sync here? :eyes:

sam: Congrats! Quick Q — what's their 95th pctl RPS target and typical prompt lengths? That drives reserved GPU count and batch config.

mira: They quoted 750 qps at 95th with avg prompt ~180 tokens, 100-token responses. They said 3% of requests will be very long (>=1k tokens).

rachel: Ok — for that mix I'd recommend a baseline of 6 T4xlarge-equivalents (or 3xA10p depending on region) reserved, plus 30% burst credit headroom. We should plan autoscale policy to allow fast burst up to 12 slots for 10m windows.

leo: Does KV warmup help for chat sessions? If they use session affinity we can reduce tail latency with prefix caching. Plan: preheat KV caches during preheat window and keep a small LRU cache pinned.

mira: They want guarantees around tail latency during peak sales events (SLA). Can we promise p50/p95/p99 numbers?

sam: We can commit p50/p95 for reserved capacity, but p99 depends on spot eviction/region failover. Recommend: include fallback model (smaller Quantized variant) in contract and an automatic region failover with degraded latency SLO.

rachel: Config snippet we plan to use (for ops handoff):
```
autoscale_policy:
  reserved_slots: 6
  burst_capacity: 6
  burst_window_seconds: 600
  kv_warmup: true
  preheat_schedule: '0300-0530 UTC'
  fallback_model: 'gpt-open-quant-8bit'
```

leo: Note on pricing: burst credits consumed above reserved will be billed at burst rate. Mira, legal asked for a clause to cap monthly burst spend as a percent of committed spend.

mira: Yes — customer wants a hard cap at 25% of committed monthly spend; legal to confirm if we can implement credit ceilings.

legal-bot: FYI — standard contract allows soft caps (alerts + throttles). Hard monetary caps need finance sign-off and escrow for unused reserved credits. I'll loop in finance.

sam: GCP network egress: Zenith requires EU data residency and uses GCP in europe-west1. If they route traffic across regions during failover, egress costs spike. Suggest we add AZ/region affinity and document failover costs in pricing appendix.

rachel: Also add a KV warmup runbook for their SREs (how to execute preheat, endpoint to warm cache, sample request generator). I can draft and attach to the deal packet.

mira: Customer also sent a security questionnaire asking about KMS and HSM for key material for private deployment. Can sales/eng confirm supported KMS options?

leo: We support Cloud KMS integrations (GCP/AWS) and HSM via customer-managed key (bring-your-own) on Private deployments. For hosted, we have KMS-backed envelope encryption; we do not expose raw keys.

mira: Great. Action items: 1) rachel draft ops runbook + KV preheat steps; 2) sam produce throughput calc showing latency assumptions and reserved->burst mapping; 3) legal-bot + finance confirm hard cap feasibility; 4) leo document KMS options and region egress note. I'll bundle for customer call Thursday.

rachel: On it. Expect runbook draft by EOD tomorrow.

sam: I'll post a short spreadsheet with per-GPU QPS estimates and cost delta for burst vs reserved by noon.

legal-bot: I'll ping finance and update here when I have confirmation. Might need 24-48 hours.

leo: KMS doc will be in this thread in ~6 hours.

ops-bot: deploy-checklist reminder: run KV warmup smoke test in staging 48h before go-live.

mira: Thanks all — this is helpful. I'll prep the Thursday agenda and include the proposed SLA language + fallback plan. :thumbsup:

rachel: quick note — if they accept quantized fallback we should run acceptance tests to check quality delta. Add eval prompt set to the runbook.

mira: added. Last message before call: is anyone concerned about the 1k+ token tail?

sam: We should route those to dedicated long-seq workers (lower batch concurrency) to avoid impacting short requests. Add a routing rule: long_seq -> long-runway pool.

mira: Perfect. Closing notes: compile all deliverables in the deal folder and ping customer. Thanks team. :rocket:
